Admission Requirements
Below are the minimum requirements for admission to each of our programs. Please note that meeting the minimum admission requirements does not guarantee admission.
MEng
Completion of an undergraduate degree equivalent to a four-year University of Toronto degree, with a minimum final year GPA of mid-B (3.0/4.0 or 75%).
Master of Engineering (MEng)
MEngCEM
Completion of an undergraduate degree equivalent to a four-year University of Toronto degree, with a minimum final year GPA of mid-B (3.0/4.0 or 75%). In addition, you must have at least one year of work/professional experience. This can include co-op or practicum experience obtained during your undergraduate degree.
Master of Engineering in Cities Engineering & Management (MEngCEM)
PhD
Full-Time PhD and Flexible-Time PhD: Completion of a master's degree and an undergraduate degree. GPA for the entire master's degree must be equivalent to a B+ (3.3/4.0 or 78%).
Direct-Entry PhD: Completion of an undergraduate degree. GPA across the entire bachelor's degree must be equivalent to an A- (3.7/4.0 or 80%).
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)
MASc
Completion of an undergraduate degree equivalent to a four-year University of Toronto degree, with a minimum final year GPA of mid-B (3.0/4.0 or 75%).
Master of Applied Science (MASc)
Application Requirements
Below is information to help you submit a complete and competitive admission application.
Degrees from outside CanadaExpand
Use the international degree equivalencies tool to see grade equivalencies and which international credentials are required for master’s and doctoral admissions at U of T.
English Language Proficiency (ELP) RequirementExpand
The ELP requirements for admission to our programs differs from those outlined on the School of Graduate Studies website. For our graduate programs, you must provide an official score from a test recognized by the School of Graduate Studies, unless any of the following exemptions apply to you:
You are a Canadian citizen who studied at a Canadian university where the language of instruction is French
You completed your admitting degree in Canada or one of the following countries/regions: Australia, the Bahamas, Barbados, Botswana, Ghana, Guyana, Hong Kong, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Malta, Namibia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Papua New Guinea, Sierra Leone, Singapore, South Africa, Swaziland, Tanzania, Trinidad and Tobago, Uganda, United Kingdom, United States of America, Zambia, and Zimbabwe
Note that official scores are not required at the time of admission, however, those admitted must meet the requirement prior to the start of their program.
Application Documents
Two references, requested and received directly through the online application system. Note that we will only review two references, even if more than two are provided. The following are acceptable referees:
Academic: an instructor or professor for a course/s you completed and can assess your ability and suitability for your proposed program of study, or program coordinator or director who is familiar with your academic performance
Research: a professor or “principal investigator” who supervised your research and can comment on your research skills and abilities
Professional: a supervisor who oversaw your work during an internship or work experience related to your proposed program of study, and can comment on your strengths and the relevance of your proposed program to your career goals
Scanned copy of transcripts, that can be from a student information system. We will ask for official transcripts from those who are admitted to one of our programs.
Resume or CV to summarize your skills, work experience, education, and achievements.
Research Statement (MASc, PhD), two pages in length, describing your research interests, and how completing a research-based graduate program will further your career and personal goals.
English Language Proficiency (ELP) scores may be required, depending on your academic background. If required, enter your scores into the application system. Please review our admission requirements to determine if you are required to submit an official ELP score to be considered for admission. You do not need to submit official scores to the University at the time of application.
Application Fee, $135, paid by the application deadline.
GRE scores are not required for admission to our programs.

Applicants who miss the application deadline for a particular start date should reach out to our admissions team to discuss what might be possible.
MASc & PhD applicants may also apply to start in either January or May. If you are interested in one of these start dates, please contact the professor(s) you are interested in working with as a supervisor. Upon their request, the admissions team can provide you with instructions on how to initiate an application outside of the standard application window (this is possible at any time during the year).
